question: With a free mediastack key (its sign-up form asks for a name, an email, a password and billing address fields, and shows no card field): at what request rate does the API answer rate_limit_reached (record the status, body and response headers), and does the 101st call of a month answer usage_limit_reached or is it served and billed as an overage? The two tests share the 100 monthly calls, so run the rate test first.
why: No first-party page states either value. The documentation of 2020 to 2026 names rate_limit_reached without a size, and the vendor's suite error table calls it a per-second or per-minute limit. The pricing page lists a per-call overage price for Standard, Professional and Business and none for the free plan, a free sign-up needs no credit card, and overage fees are charged to a credit card. The plan FAQ said in April 2023 that API access will be disabled after 100% of the allowance and said by January 2025 that overage fees apply, naming no plan; the usage-limit text of the service terms says the API returns an error and answers no further calls after the monthly limit. Only a free key settles it.
